name: pi-web-box
description: A quiet Windows desktop window for Pi Web
author: Pi Web Box

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:both: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never
